source_text: Andrea, I can explain!

structure.raw_value: McWoCl.Andrea, I can explain!
structure.script_literal: "McWoCl.Andrea, I can explain!"

translation: Andrea, mogę wyjaśnić!

source_text: Explain what? There is nothing that can be done now.

structure.raw_value: AdAnOp.Explain what? There is nothing that can be done now.
structure.script_literal: "AdAnOp.Explain what? There is nothing that can be done now."

translation: Co tu wyjaśniać? Teraz już nic się nie da zrobić.

source_text: It was a one-time thing… It won't happen again.

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.It was a one-time thing… It won't happen again.
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.It was a one-time thing… It won't happen again."

translation: To był jednorazowy wybryk… Już się nie powtórzy.

source_text: It’s not true! That was Ella’s account!

structure.raw_value: McWoCl@>.It’s not true! That was Ella’s account!
structure.script_literal: "McWoCl@>.It’s not true! That was Ella’s account!"

translation: To nieprawda! To było konto Elli!

source_text: It doesn’t matter. You can't be the face of the operation anymore.

structure.raw_value: AdAnEx.It doesn’t matter. You can't be the face of the operation anymore.
structure.script_literal: "AdAnEx.It doesn’t matter. You can't be the face of the operation anymore."

translation: Nieważne. Nie możesz już być twarzą operacji.

source_text: What a vulture… Foxx can’t help herself.

structure.raw_value: AdAnDe.What a vulture… Foxx can’t help herself.
structure.script_literal: "AdAnDe.What a vulture… Foxx can’t help herself."

translation: Co za sęp… Foxx nie potrafi się powstrzymać.

source_text: Well… What now?

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.Well… What now?
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.Well… What now?"

translation: No więc… Co teraz?

source_text: You’re fired.

structure.raw_value: AdAnEx.You’re fired.
structure.script_literal: "AdAnEx.You’re fired."

translation: Jesteś zwolniony.

source_text: We’re going in a new direction.

structure.raw_value: AdAnOp.We’re going in a new direction.
structure.script_literal: "AdAnOp.We’re going in a new direction."

translation: Idziemy w nowym kierunku.

source_text: But, Andrea…

structure.raw_value: McSaCl.But, Andrea…
structure.script_literal: "McSaCl.But, Andrea…"

translation: Ale, Andrea…

source_text: You’re on my undercover team now. We can use this to disconnect you from the station.

structure.raw_value: AdAnEx.You’re on my undercover team now. We can use this to disconnect you from the station.
structure.script_literal: "AdAnEx.You’re on my undercover team now. We can use this to disconnect you from the station."

translation: Jesteś teraz w moim zespole pod przykrywką. Możemy wykorzystać to, by odciąć cię od stacji.

source_text: It means you’ll be operating under a new set of rules.

structure.raw_value: AdFlDe.It means you’ll be operating under a new set of rules.
structure.script_literal: "AdFlDe.It means you’ll be operating under a new set of rules."

translation: To oznacza, że będziesz działać według nowych zasad.

source_text: You’re a rogue agent now. You’ll follow my lead.

structure.raw_value: AdBaEx.You’re a rogue agent now. You’ll follow my lead.
structure.script_literal: "AdBaEx.You’re a rogue agent now. You’ll follow my lead."

translation: Jesteś teraz agentem-rogue. Będziesz podążać za mną.

source_text: Rogue agent?

structure.raw_value: McWoCl.Rogue agent?
structure.script_literal: "McWoCl.Rogue agent?"

translation: Agentem-rogue?

source_text: Meet me at my home later this afternoon. I’ve got a mission for you and Nellie…

structure.raw_value: AdBaEx.Meet me at my home later this afternoon. I’ve got a mission for you and Nellie…
structure.script_literal: "AdBaEx.Meet me at my home later this afternoon. I’ve got a mission for you and Nellie…"

translation: Spotkajmy się u mnie dziś po południu. Mam misję dla ciebie i Nellie…

source_text: You two are going to finish this.

structure.raw_value: AdFlEx.You two are going to finish this.
structure.script_literal: "AdFlEx.You two are going to finish this."

translation: Wy to dokończycie.

source_text: Clean out your desk. You’re off the force…

structure.raw_value: AdBaOp.Clean out your desk. You’re off the force…
structure.script_literal: "AdBaOp.Clean out your desk. You’re off the force…"

translation: Wyczyść biurko. Wylatujesz ze służby…

source_text: You’re going to be escorted off the premises.

structure.raw_value: AdBaEx.You’re going to be escorted off the premises.
structure.script_literal: "AdBaEx.You’re going to be escorted off the premises."

translation: Zostaniesz wyprowadzony z budynku.

source_text: Fuck… I’m sorry, Andrea.

structure.raw_value: McSaOp.Fuck… I’m sorry, Andrea.
structure.script_literal: "McSaOp.Fuck… I’m sorry, Andrea."

translation: Cholera… Przepraszam, Andrea.

source_text: God damn it… Serves me right for trusting that Tasha girl.

structure.raw_value: McAnDe.God damn it… Serves me right for trusting that Tasha girl.
structure.script_literal: "McAnDe.God damn it… Serves me right for trusting that Tasha girl."

translation: Cholera jasna… Dobrze mi tak, że zaufałem tej dziewczynie Taszy.

source_text: Why the hell did she record us?

structure.raw_value: McSaDe.Why the hell did she record us?
structure.script_literal: "McSaDe.Why the hell did she record us?"

translation: Czemu, do cholery, nas nagrywała?

source_text: I’m sorry, Andrea.

structure.raw_value: McSaOp.I’m sorry, Andrea.
structure.script_literal: "McSaOp.I’m sorry, Andrea."

translation: Przepraszam, Andrea.

source_text: Ready for a new day, Canmore?

structure.raw_value: AdFlOp.Ready for a new day, Canmore?
structure.script_literal: "AdFlOp.Ready for a new day, Canmore?"

translation: Gotowy na nowy dzień, Canmore?

source_text: Andrea… We need to talk.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.Andrea… We need to talk.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.Andrea… We need to talk."

translation: Andrea… Musimy porozmawiać.

source_text: Lillian.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.Lillian.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.Lillian."

translation: Lillian.

source_text: Elaborate.

structure.raw_value: AdBaDe.Elaborate.
structure.script_literal: "AdBaDe.Elaborate."

translation: Rozwiń.

source_text: Erica… Lillian’s maid and the priest from Eve Cathedral… They went to check up on her.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.Erica… Lillian’s maid and the priest from Eve Cathedral… They went to check up on her.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.Erica… Lillian’s maid and the priest from Eve Cathedral… They went to check up on her."

translation: Erica… pokojówka Lillian i ksiądz z katedry Eve… Poszli ją sprawdzić.

source_text: Duncan has new goons and the mansion is crawling with them…

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.Duncan has new goons and the mansion is crawling with them…
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.Duncan has new goons and the mansion is crawling with them…"

translation: Duncan ma nowych zbirów i rezydencja aż się od nich roi…

source_text: They got captured and we had to break out.

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.They got captured and we had to break out.
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.They got captured and we had to break out."

translation: Zostali złapani i musieliśmy się wyrwać.

source_text: We? You got captured?

structure.raw_value: AdShOp.We? You got captured?
structure.script_literal: "AdShOp.We? You got captured?"

translation: My? Dałeś się złapać?

source_text: You know Duncan is there. Tell me what’s going on.

structure.raw_value: McAnDe.You know Duncan is there. Tell me what’s going on.
structure.script_literal: "McAnDe.You know Duncan is there. Tell me what’s going on."

translation: Wiesz, że Duncan tam jest. Powiedz mi, co się dzieje.

source_text: What did you expect? We had to find Lillian.

structure.raw_value: McAnEx.What did you expect? We had to find Lillian.
structure.script_literal: "McAnEx.What did you expect? We had to find Lillian."

translation: Czego się spodziewałeś? Musieliśmy odnaleźć Lillian.

source_text: That woman has disappeared. She’s probably not even at the mansion.

structure.raw_value: AdAnEx.That woman has disappeared. She’s probably not even at the mansion.
structure.script_literal: "AdAnEx.That woman has disappeared. She’s probably not even at the mansion."

translation: Ta kobieta zniknęła. Pewnie nawet nie ma jej w rezydencji.

source_text: That’s not true. She was hiding.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.That’s not true. She was hiding.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.That’s not true. She was hiding."

translation: To nieprawda. Ukrywała się.

source_text: You found her?

structure.raw_value: AdBaDe.You found her?
structure.script_literal: "AdBaDe.You found her?"

translation: Znaleźliście ją?

source_text: We did and she was chased away… We don’t know where she is now.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.We did and she was chased away… We don’t know where she is now.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.We did and she was chased away… We don’t know where she is now."

translation: Tak, ale została przegnana… Nie wiemy, gdzie teraz jest.

source_text: Father Solomon and Erica are now in danger. Duncan knows about them.

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.Father Solomon and Erica are now in danger. Duncan knows about them.
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.Father Solomon and Erica are now in danger. Duncan knows about them."

translation: Ojciec Solomon i Erica są teraz w niebezpieczeństwie. Duncan o nich wie.

source_text: They aren’t in danger. I’ll handle this.

structure.raw_value: AdAnOp.They aren’t in danger. I’ll handle this.
structure.script_literal: "AdAnOp.They aren’t in danger. I’ll handle this."

translation: Nie są w niebezpieczeństwie. Ja się tym zajmę.

source_text: Forgive me for not simply trusting you, but these people are innocent bystanders. I need to know exactly what’s going on.

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.Forgive me for not simply trusting you, but these people are innocent bystanders. I need to know exactly what’s going on.
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.Forgive me for not simply trusting you, but these people are innocent bystanders. I need to know exactly what’s going on."

translation: Wybacz, że tak po prostu ci nie ufam, ale to niewinni ludzie. Muszę wiedzieć dokładnie, co się dzieje.

source_text: Very well…

structure.raw_value: AdAnDe.Very well…
structure.script_literal: "AdAnDe.Very well…"

translation: Dobrze…

source_text: I’ll go to the cathedral and personally meet with the priest.

structure.raw_value: AdAnEx.I’ll go to the cathedral and personally meet with the priest.
structure.script_literal: "AdAnEx.I’ll go to the cathedral and personally meet with the priest."

translation: Pójdę do katedry i osobiście spotkam się z księdzem.

source_text: Will you bring officers?

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.Will you bring officers?
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.Will you bring officers?"

translation: Zabierzesz funkcjonariuszy?

source_text: That won't be necessary.

structure.raw_value: AdBaOp.That won't be necessary.
structure.script_literal: "AdBaOp.That won't be necessary."

translation: Nie będzie to konieczne.

source_text: Because I have Duncan under tight control.

structure.raw_value: AdAnEx.Because I have Duncan under tight control.
structure.script_literal: "AdAnEx.Because I have Duncan under tight control."

translation: Bo mam Duncana pod ścisłą kontrolą.

source_text: You’re controlling Duncan?

structure.raw_value: McShOpNo1.You’re controlling Duncan?
structure.script_literal: "McShOpNo1.You’re controlling Duncan?"

translation: Kontrolujesz Duncana?

source_text: Trust me. He won’t be bothering them anymore.

structure.raw_value: AdFlDe.Trust me. He won’t be bothering them anymore.
structure.script_literal: "AdFlDe.Trust me. He won’t be bothering them anymore."

translation: Zaufaj mi. Nie będzie już ich niepokoić.

source_text: Move along, 1Hero. I have other work to attend to.

structure.raw_value: AdAnEx.Move along, 1Hero. I have other work to attend to.
structure.script_literal: "AdAnEx.Move along, 1Hero. I have other work to attend to."

translation: Idź dalej, 1Hero. Mam inne sprawy.

source_text: Andrea… Duncan wasn’t there.

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.Andrea… Duncan wasn’t there.
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.Andrea… Duncan wasn’t there."

translation: Andrea… Duncana tam nie było.

source_text: Here she is, commissioner.

structure.raw_value: OaBaEx^.Here she is, commissioner.
structure.script_literal: "OaBaEx^.Here she is, commissioner."

translation: Oto ona, pani komisarz.

source_text: Leave us.

structure.raw_value: AdAnOp.Leave us.
structure.script_literal: "AdAnOp.Leave us."

translation: Zostaw nas.

source_text: The cops showed up! I shot at them, but…

structure.raw_value: NeWoEx^.The cops showed up! I shot at them, but…
structure.script_literal: "NeWoEx^.The cops showed up! I shot at them, but…"

translation: Gliniarze się zjawili! Strzelałem do nich, ale…

source_text: They are still alive!

structure.raw_value: AdMaOpNo1.They are still alive!
structure.script_literal: "AdMaOpNo1.They are still alive!"

translation: Wciąż żyją!

source_text: They got arrested. What else could we have done?

structure.raw_value: McAnEx.They got arrested. What else could we have done?
structure.script_literal: "McAnEx.They got arrested. What else could we have done?"

translation: Zostali aresztowani. Co innego mogliśmy zrobić?

source_text: What the hell was Bhatt doing at the warehouse?

structure.raw_value: AdAnDe.What the hell was Bhatt doing at the warehouse?
structure.script_literal: "AdAnDe.What the hell was Bhatt doing at the warehouse?"

translation: Co, do cholery, robiła Bhatt w magazynie?

source_text: She tells me an anonymous tip came in about Jon’s warehouse…

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.She tells me an anonymous tip came in about Jon’s warehouse…
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.She tells me an anonymous tip came in about Jon’s warehouse…"

translation: Mówi, że wpłynął anonimowy tip o magazynie Jona…

source_text: Must have been a coincidence.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.Must have been a coincidence.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.Must have been a coincidence."

translation: Musiało to być przypadek.

source_text: I don’t believe in coincidences…

structure.raw_value: AdAnOp.I don’t believe in coincidences…
structure.script_literal: "AdAnOp.I don’t believe in coincidences…"

translation: Nie wierzę w przypadki…

source_text: Paul must have been listening on the scanner too… Damn.

structure.raw_value: AdAnDe.Paul must have been listening on the scanner too… Damn.
structure.script_literal: "AdAnDe.Paul must have been listening on the scanner too… Damn."

translation: Paul musiał też nasłuchiwać skanera… Cholera.

source_text: The place was packed. It didn’t go down like you said.

structure.raw_value: NeWoEx^.The place was packed. It didn’t go down like you said.
structure.script_literal: "NeWoEx^.The place was packed. It didn’t go down like you said."

translation: Miejsce było nabite. Nie poszło tak, jak mówiłaś.

source_text: Even if it had, Duncan was missing. Sounds like the whole plan failed on that front…

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.Even if it had, Duncan was missing. Sounds like the whole plan failed on that front…
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.Even if it had, Duncan was missing. Sounds like the whole plan failed on that front…"

translation: Nawet gdyby poszło, Duncana brakowało. Wygląda na to, że cały plan zawalił się na tym froncie…

source_text: But what does it matter now? We need to find Duncan.

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.But what does it matter now? We need to find Duncan.
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.But what does it matter now? We need to find Duncan."

translation: Ale jakie to ma teraz znaczenie? Musimy znaleźć Duncana.

source_text: Kimberly is going to want an interview and we’re not telling her about Duncan…

structure.raw_value: AdAnEx.Kimberly is going to want an interview and we’re not telling her about Duncan…
structure.script_literal: "AdAnEx.Kimberly is going to want an interview and we’re not telling her about Duncan…"

translation: Kimberly będzie chciała wywiadu, a my nie mówimy jej o Duncanie…

source_text: The case is closed today.

structure.raw_value: AdAnDe.The case is closed today.
structure.script_literal: "AdAnDe.The case is closed today."

translation: Sprawa jest dziś zamknięta.

source_text: We’re still interrogating his goons.

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.We’re still interrogating his goons.
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.We’re still interrogating his goons."

translation: Wciąż przesłuchujemy jego ludzi.

source_text: You’re not doing anything, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: AdAnEx.You’re not doing anything, 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "AdAnEx.You’re not doing anything, 1Hero."

translation: Ty nic nie robisz, 1Hero.

source_text: It doesn’t matter what they say. The Guild dies tonight.

structure.raw_value: AdAnDe.It doesn’t matter what they say. The Guild dies tonight.
structure.script_literal: "AdAnDe.It doesn’t matter what they say. The Guild dies tonight."

translation: Nieważne, co powiedzą. Gildia umiera dziś wieczorem.

source_text: Does this mean I’m a free woman?

structure.raw_value: NeFrOp^.Does this mean I’m a free woman?
structure.script_literal: "NeFrOp^.Does this mean I’m a free woman?"

translation: Czy to oznacza, że jestem wolną kobietą?

source_text: You didn’t obey orders.

structure.raw_value: AdAnOp.You didn’t obey orders.
structure.script_literal: "AdAnOp.You didn’t obey orders."

translation: Nie wykonałaś rozkazów.

source_text: Hey! I did my best!

structure.raw_value: NeAnOp^.Hey! I did my best!
structure.script_literal: "NeAnOp^.Hey! I did my best!"

translation: Hej! Starałam się jak mogłam!

source_text: This isn’t over for you, Miss Cole.

structure.raw_value: AdAnEx.This isn’t over for you, Miss Cole.
structure.script_literal: "AdAnEx.This isn’t over for you, Miss Cole."

translation: To jeszcze nie koniec, panno Cole.

source_text: Is the Guild operation finished? What about the bigger team? There are more of us, right?

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.Is the Guild operation finished? What about the bigger team? There are more of us, right?
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.Is the Guild operation finished? What about the bigger team? There are more of us, right?"

translation: Czy operacja Gildii jest zakończona? A co z większą ekipą? Jest nas więcej, prawda?

source_text: Don’t worry about anyone but yourself, 1Hero. I’ll deal with closing the case.

structure.raw_value: AdAnDe.Don’t worry about anyone but yourself, 1Hero. I’ll deal with closing the case.
structure.script_literal: "AdAnDe.Don’t worry about anyone but yourself, 1Hero. I’ll deal with closing the case."

translation: Nie martw się o nikogo poza sobą, 1Hero. Ja zajmę się zamknięciem sprawy.

source_text: Let me go on the news. I can spin a story that’ll keep everyone off your tail.

structure.raw_value: NeHaEx^.Let me go on the news. I can spin a story that’ll keep everyone off your tail.
structure.script_literal: "NeHaEx^.Let me go on the news. I can spin a story that’ll keep everyone off your tail."

translation: Pozwól mi wystąpić w wiadomościach. Mogę ukręcić historię, która odciągnie od ciebie wszystkich.

source_text: Absolutely not. 1Hero can handle this.

structure.raw_value: AdAnEx.Absolutely not. 1Hero can handle this.
structure.script_literal: "AdAnEx.Absolutely not. 1Hero can handle this."

translation: Absolutnie nie. 1Hero sobie z tym poradzi.

source_text: It just so happens that Kimberly is interested in a live interview.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.It just so happens that Kimberly is interested in a live interview.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.It just so happens that Kimberly is interested in a live interview."

translation: Tak się składa, że Kimberly jest zainteresowana wywiadem na żywo.

source_text: Then our future here is on your shoulders.

structure.raw_value: AdBaDe.Then our future here is on your shoulders.
structure.script_literal: "AdBaDe.Then our future here is on your shoulders."

translation: Więc nasza przyszłość spoczywa na twoich barkach.

source_text: You need to finish this.

structure.raw_value: AdAnEx.You need to finish this.
structure.script_literal: "AdAnEx.You need to finish this."

translation: Musisz to dokończyć.

source_text: If the Guild case is closed, what the hell am I supposed to do now?

structure.raw_value: NeAnOp^.If the Guild case is closed, what the hell am I supposed to do now?
structure.script_literal: "NeAnOp^.If the Guild case is closed, what the hell am I supposed to do now?"

translation: Jeśli sprawa Gildii jest zamknięta, to co ja mam, do cholery, teraz robić?

source_text: I’ve got plans.

structure.raw_value: AdAnEx.I’ve got plans.
structure.script_literal: "AdAnEx.I’ve got plans."

translation: Mam plany.

source_text: Well… While you have plans, I've lost my place to stay.

structure.raw_value: NeAnDe^.Well… While you have plans, I've lost my place to stay.
structure.script_literal: "NeAnDe^.Well… While you have plans, I've lost my place to stay."

translation: Cóż… Póki ty masz plany, ja straciłam dach nad głową.

source_text: You’ll come home with me. We can discuss our future there.

structure.raw_value: AdAnEx.You’ll come home with me. We can discuss our future there.
structure.script_literal: "AdAnEx.You’ll come home with me. We can discuss our future there."

translation: Zamieszkasz ze mną. Możemy tam omówić naszą przyszłość.

source_text: You promised my record would be cleared.

structure.raw_value: NeSaOp^.You promised my record would be cleared.
structure.script_literal: "NeSaOp^.You promised my record would be cleared."

translation: Obiecałaś, że moja kartoteka zostanie wyczyszczona.

source_text: And you promised to kill Duncan’s henchmen.

structure.raw_value: AdAnEx.And you promised to kill Duncan’s henchmen.
structure.script_literal: "AdAnEx.And you promised to kill Duncan’s henchmen."

translation: A ty obiecałeś zabić ludzi Duncana.

source_text: It’s time to leave…

structure.raw_value: AdAnOp.It’s time to leave…
structure.script_literal: "AdAnOp.It’s time to leave…"

translation: Czas ruszać…

source_text: You know what to do, right, 1Hero?

structure.raw_value: AdAnEx.You know what to do, right, 1Hero?
structure.script_literal: "AdAnEx.You know what to do, right, 1Hero?"

translation: Wiesz, co robić, prawda, 1Hero?
